svg.aria-label: Sixteen rows, one for each anniversary of 14 June from 2014 to 2029. Each row marks two positions: where the date lands when folded to a single digit, on a track of nine slots, and where the same date lands on the wheel of twenty-two. The folded marker steps forward one slot a year and returns to its starting slot every nine years. The wheel marker also steps forward, but thirteen of its slots are tinted as cards a folded digit can never name, and in 2029 the marker sits inside that tinted band, on Justice at eleven.
svg.text: Every 14 June from 2014 to 2029, placed twice.
shaded: the 13 a digit can’t name
The digit returns to its slot every nine years, exactly.
2014 and 2023 both land on the Hierophant.
2029 lands on Justice, card 11. No folded digit reaches it.
